statements.text: An empty model name is refused. A writer with no model gives no model key instead.
live_cases: set_embedding_identity with a blank model key -> ValueError
statements.notes: set_embedding_identity normalizes the offered key; normalize_model_key raises ValueError for a blank key; 0 journal records. A writer with no model offers the undeclared identity (identity_from_config(None): mechanism and model_key None, observation in the log).

statements.text: A way of making vectors that is not one of the three known ways is refused.
live_cases: set_embedding_identity with mechanism 'word2vec' -> ValueError
IRISGraphEngine path: identity_from_config(mechanism='word2vec') -> ValueError
statements.notes: Both entry points refuse 'word2vec' with ValueError naming the closed set; 0 journal records.

statements.text: A write is refused when its identity clashes with its registry row. Nothing is written then.
live_cases: store_embeddings batch at width 5 into a width-4 route -> EmbeddingIdentityConflict, names the graph, writes nothing
store_embedding by an embedding_config writer into a route claimed by sentence-transformers -> EmbeddingIdentityConflict, writes nothing
statements.notes: A width clash (batch of 5-wide vectors into a 4-wide route) and a mechanism clash (sentence-transformers claim vs an embedding_config writer of the same model name) both raise EmbeddingIdentityConflict before any INSERT; the width case names graph 'rx06g13'; 0 journal records in both windows.

statements.text: A write is refused when the registry is there but cannot be read.
statements.notes: Live as IVGAUDIT_RO (database RW for the window only; SELECT on every Graph_KG table but embedding_registry; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on the target tables): on a fresh engine the write is refused, but by the route lookup, not by the identity check (frames store_embedding -> _route_for_write -> _read_route, embeddings.py:420-427 re-raises any failure but -30, R161) for both a routed model and the default pair. Once a route is cached (30 s, embeddings.py:313-336), the identity check is the only registry read: after SELECT on the registry was revoked (CheckPrivilege 0), a second store_embedding on the same engine returned True and wrote its row (get_embedding_identity answers None on the -99, schema.py:1054-1056; enforce lets it through, 1383-1385). The stated refusal is therefore not implemented by the code that states it (F-0601), and holds only incidentally on a cache miss. Earlier: stand-in cursor probes (breadth-a-probe-local-0101-0601, rx-probe-06-local).
live_cases: r2 (a) fresh engine, routed model rxp-m1, no SELECT on the registry -> refused
r2 (b) fresh engine, default pair, no SELECT on the registry -> refused
r2 (c) route cached, then SELECT on the registry revoked: second write -> refused (stated)

statements.text: Setting another model on a claimed row is refused.
live_cases: set_embedding_identity rx06-m2 on a row claimed for rx06-m1 -> EmbeddingIdentityConflict
statements.notes: A row claimed for rx06-m1 refuses rx06-m2 with EmbeddingIdentityConflict; registry row unchanged; 0 journal records.

statements.text: Setting an identity with no model is refused. Only adopting writes a row with no model key.
live_cases: set_embedding_identity with the undeclared identity -> ValueError
set_embedding_identity(None) -> ValueError
statements.notes: Undeclared identity and None both refused with ValueError; 0 journal records.

statements.text: An identity can be set only on a table that holds node vectors. Any other table is refused.
live_cases: set_embedding_identity on table 'nodes' -> ValueError
set_embedding_identity on an edge route name kg_eemb_<16 hex> -> ValueError
statements.notes: 'nodes' and an edge route name kg_eemb_<16 hex> both refused with ValueError; 0 journal records.

statements.text: Setup will not change the width of an empty vector table unless asked. It never changes the width of a table that holds vectors.
live_cases: initialize_schema at width 6 over empty width-4 columns, no rewidth -> EmbeddingIdentityConflict before setup writes
initialize_schema(rewidth=True) at width 6 while kg_NodeEmbeddings holds a vector -> EmbeddingIdentityConflict before setup writes
statements.notes: initialize_schema at width 6 over empty width-4 columns (no rewidth) and with rewidth=True while kg_NodeEmbeddings holds a vector: both raise EmbeddingIdentityConflict before setup writes (0 journal records); column widths stay 4.

statements.text: Making a new route is refused inside a transaction the caller opened.
live_cases: store_embedding into an unrouted pair inside the caller's transaction -> CallerTransactionOpenError, no route made
statements.notes: Inside a caller transaction (START TRANSACTION + INSERT, $TLEVEL 1) a write needing a new route raises CallerTransactionOpenError; 0 journal records; no route after the rollback.

statements.text: A route table that outlived its row at another width is refused, and no row is added.
statements.notes: Upstream unit tests (stand-in cursor) PASSED here. Not probed live: a routed table that outlived its registry row arises only from an interrupted writer, a lost race or a direct registry edit; this lane does not edit product tables to stage it.

statements.text: Any other failed registry read raises. It never falls back to the legacy table.
statements.notes: Upstream unit tests PASSED here; rx-probe-06-local also shows _read_route raising on a SQLCODE -99 registry read (pin code, stand-in cursor). Not live: needs a user who may not read the registry.

statements.text: Storing a node's vector is refused when the node is not in that graph.
live_cases: store_embedding for a node that exists only in another graph -> ValueError
store_embedding for a node in no graph -> ValueError
statements.notes: A node present only in the default graph, stored for graph rx06g31, and a node in no graph: ValueError 'Node does not exist in graph'; 0 journal records.

statements.text: A vector whose width differs from its route's width is refused, and the error names the graph.
live_cases: store_embedding 5-wide into graph rx06g32's 4-wide route -> refused, error names the graph
statements.notes: 5-wide vector into graph rx06g32's 4-wide route: EmbeddingIdentityConflict naming graph 'rx06g32'; route row count unchanged; 0 journal records.

statements.text: A batch that holds two widths is refused before anything is written.
live_cases: store_embeddings with widths 4 and 5 -> ValueError before anything (no route made)
statements.notes: Batch with widths [4, 5]: ValueError before any route or row; 0 journal records.

statements.text: A batch refused for a missing node leaves no new route behind.
live_cases: store_embeddings into an unrouted pair with one missing node -> refused, no new route left
statements.notes: Reproduced live: the batch is refused (ValueError for the missing node) after _route_for_write made the new route: the journal shows a new embedding_registry row (kg_emb_..., graph rx06g39, set_by routed) and the routed table's class storage (^oddTSQL); 90 records. F-0615.

statements.text: The tool that fills the second legacy table checks the identity too. It must not skip it.
live_cases: VectorOptimizer.migrate_to_optimized copies rx06-src vectors into a table claimed for rx06-dst -> refused by the identity check
statements.notes: Not implemented: migrate_to_optimized has no identity check (F-0613, source). Live on IRIS 2026.1 the tool cannot reach its copy loop: its CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ... AS HNSW is rejected (SQLCODE -1, 'ON expected'), so it returns success False with that SQL error and copies nothing - a failure for another reason, not the stated identity refusal (F-C0615).

statements.text: A failed count or listing raises. It never answers zero or an empty list instead.
statements.notes: embedding_count re-raises any failure but a missing table (2156-2162); get_unembedded_nodes has no except at all (917-939), so a failed listing raises. Upstream unit tests PASSED here; rx-probe-06-local shows embedding_count raising on SQLCODE -99. A failing count cannot be produced live without a restricted user.

statements.text: A query vector whose width differs from the route's is refused before any search runs. The error names both widths.
live_cases: kg_KNN_VEC with a 5-wide query on a 4-wide route -> ValueError naming both widths
search_nodes_by_vector with a 5-wide query on a 4-wide route -> ValueError
statements.notes: kg_KNN_VEC and search_nodes_by_vector with a 5-wide query on a 4-wide route: ValueError naming 5 and 4 before any search statement; 0 journal records.

statements.text: A search that names a graph or a model is refused when only an IVF index could answer it.
statements.dependency: an IRIS server without native VECTOR_COSINE (before 2024.1); this 2026.1 server has it (_probe_native_vec True), so search_nodes_by_vector never reaches its IVF branch
statements.notes: Corroboration only (SIMULATED, not counted as live): with the engine's cached native-vector probe forced to False on the real engine, search_nodes_by_vector naming a graph or a model raised ValueError with 0 journal records (cases 'SIMULATED no-VECTOR_COSINE ...' in rx-live-06).

statements.text: A table search of a route with no graph named is refused before it runs.
live_cases: vector_search on a node route (kg_emb_) with no graph -> ValueError
vector_search on an edge route (kg_eemb_) with no graph -> ValueError
statements.notes: Holds for a node route (kg_emb_: ValueError); not for an edge route: vector_search over kg_eemb_ with no graph ran and returned a row ('rx06:s1', score 1) - the name test checks only the kg_emb_ prefix (vector.py:1212). Live reproduction of the kg_eemb_ half of F-0612 (disposition confirmed-source until now).

statements.text: An identity clash during a bulk embed is raised to the caller, not only counted.
live_cases: embed_nodes whose batch clashes with the route's width -> EmbeddingIdentityConflict raised
statements.notes: Reproduced live: embed_nodes over graph rx06g67 with 5-wide vectors into a 4-wide route returned {'embedded': 0, 'errors': 2, ...} and logged the EmbeddingIdentityConflict; only CallerTransactionOpenError is re-raised (1472-1473). F-0614.

statements.text: Queuing a node that already waits for another graph is refused. The count of queued items shows it.
live_cases: enqueue the same node for rx06qb while pending for rx06qa -> count 0, entry unchanged
statements.notes: Node pending for rx06qa; enqueue for rx06qb answers 0 and leaves the entry (graph rx06qa, PENDING); 0 journal records.

statements.text: Work for a model that the registry refuses is not queued. Nothing is queued then.
live_cases: enqueue_for_embedding with a config the kg_NodeEmbeddings row refuses -> EmbeddingIdentityConflict, nothing queued
statements.notes: kg_NodeEmbeddings claimed for rx06-qm; enqueue with config rx06-other raises EmbeddingIdentityConflict; nothing queued (entry absent); 0 journal records.

statements.text: An entry that asks for a model other than the worker's is marked failed, with the reason. The rest of the batch goes on.
live_cases: process_embed_queue: entry for another model marked ERROR with the reason, the other entry DONE (writes by design: queue status, the honoured vector and its route)
statements.notes: Worker with model rx06-worker: the entry asking rx06-other is marked ERROR with the conflict reason, the other entry is DONE and its vector stored ({'processed': 1, 'errors': 1}); no vector for the refused node. The statement says the entry is marked, so queue and route writes are expected (the case allows them and checks the outcome).

statements.text: The server worker marks an entry failed when its node is not in its graph, or the graph has no route.
live_cases: server ProcessBatch: node not in its graph, and a graph with no route -> both ERROR, no vector written (only the queue entries change)
statements.notes: Server Graph.KG.EmbedQueue.ProcessBatch: node not in its queued graph -> ERROR 'is not in graph'; node in a graph with no route -> ERROR 'no embedding route'; {'processed': 0, 'errors': 2}; the journal shows writes to ^EmbedQueue only (no vector table, no registry).

statements.text: An inventory that cannot read a registry that is there raises. It does not give an empty report.
statements.notes: The pin answers [] (rx-probe-06-local: embedding_inventory returned [] for a SQLCODE -99 registry read). The statement (uplift ontology, cites ADMIN_GUIDE.md:1131-1145, which does not state it) says it raises; the pin's own docstring says 'An unreadable registry yields []... a status command must not raise on one' (schema.py:1738-1739). F-0601's text covers the write path only; the inventory half is a documented choice of the code, so the intent is undecided. Not triggerable live without a restricted user.
